title: Enoch readings
credit: Original desk list of Scripture and 1 Enoch passages. Not J. J. Hurtak’s Keys of Enoch (1973/1977/2009), which is in copyright and is not shipped.

sections.title: Genesis 5:21–24
paragraphs: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him. That is the first Scriptural Enoch. Jude 14–15 then cites Enoch the seventh from Adam.

sections.title: 1 Enoch 1
paragraphs: Charles 1913, already on this desk, opens with Enoch’s blessing on the elect. Open Extra-canon to 1 Enoch, Chapter 1. Hurtak’s later “keys” are a twentieth-century book and are not this chapter.

sections.title: 1 Enoch 14
paragraphs: Enoch is taken into a house of hailstones and fire and sees a throne. Read it beside Ezekiel 1 and Revelation 4. The desk study is the public-domain Charles text, not a modern key system.

sections.title: Watchers and Azazel
paragraphs: 1 Enoch 6–10 names the watchers and Azazel. Leviticus 16 already has Azazel on the Day of Atonement. The names-of-powers glossary on Strong’s points at both without copying a dictionary article.
